result_preview.description: Exposes customer account records and safety campaign data to retrieve compliance inspection status, manage customer engagement in safety programs, and provide access to historical campaign performance metrics. Integrates service tickets with customer-level safety requirements for coordinated incident response and regulatory reporting.

result_preview.title: Safety Incident Order Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Exposes safety incident records linked to customer orders and accounts for compliance tracking.
result_preview.description: This API retrieves and manages safety incident data associated with customer accounts and orders, enabling integration of incident records with order fulfillment workflows. It provides access to incident classifications, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance status tied to specific customer transactions. The resource supports service management operations by exposing incident-to-order relationships for ticket lifecycle tracking and incident investigation coordination.

result_preview.title: Customer Order Fulfillment Tracking API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages customer order status, fulfillment milestones, and delivery tracking data.
result_preview.description: This API exposes real-time customer order fulfillment data, enabling applications to retrieve order details, track shipment progress, and manage delivery status updates. It provides access to comprehensive order lifecycle information across customer accounts, supporting both order status queries and fulfillment event management for seamless customer service operations.
